retainedDemo.scope: Active eleven-villa project, completed reference, editable BOQ intake and pending practice actions; permission-aware bilingual guide; report schedules paused and external transports disabled.

steps.title: Project, cost centre, WBS and building/floor setup
steps.operatorFlow: Select the legal entity, retain the handover-created project/cost centre, define real buildings/floors/zones and disciplines, then submit a BOQ quantity/budget allocation for finance approval.
steps.implementation: Native analytic cost centre; permanent project/location/discipline identity; released-budget and currency locking; capped, immutable and dated building allocation plans.

steps.title: Certificate rejection and resubmission
steps.operatorFlow: Submit measurement to the configured review route; record a reasoned return, correct the draft and resubmit to a new review cycle.
steps.implementation: Technical/commercial/finance route, return/resubmit controls and immutable actor/quantity/decision history.

steps.title: Reviewed Excel BOQ intake
steps.operatorFlow: Add workbooks to a draft estimate, map columns, review file/sheet/row errors and totals, confirm the reviewed source and commit once.
steps.implementation: Multi-file/sheet named mappings, retained provenance, formula/numeric/UOM/duplicate validation, stale-evidence detection and atomic idempotent typed-line import.
steps.boundary: Structured reviewed import is implemented; uncertain/unstructured extraction and assisted assembly suggestions are separate SOW conditions.

steps.title: Parent/child allocation caps
steps.operatorFlow: Define parent BOQ caps and percentage-valued children; check allocation totals and submit only a fully reviewed hierarchy.
steps.implementation: Stable identities, explicit percentage/monetary limits and leaf-only costing/snapshots/handover without parent double-counting.

steps.title: Separate cost, overhead and profit
steps.operatorFlow: Review resource/direct costs, the separate indirect allocation, overhead/profit and existing markup basis; compare versions, approve and hand over without re-entry.
steps.implementation: Frozen direct-cost, direct-plus-indirect budget and selling figures, approved snapshot enforcement, company-currency native quotation/analytic/project/WBS handover and draft before/after evidence.
steps.boundary: Handover uses company currency and the product primary UOM. Foreign source amounts remain preserved; FX and secondary-UOM transactional acceptance remain separately governed.

steps.title: Post-award BOQ revisions
steps.operatorFlow: Submit priced additions or unperformed-scope omissions on the same contract; approve their variation/budget effects and inspect the current BOQ alongside its original award.
steps.implementation: Controlled same-contract revision, original-value retention, source-linked additions and measurement limits without double invoice deductions or rewriting awarded lines.
steps.boundary: This is not arbitrary rate rewriting, legal contract-clause acceptance or every commercial amendment case.

steps.title: Material demand to procurement, stock and job cost
steps.operatorFlow: Approve site demand, check unreserved stores, prepare a partial issue/shortage PR, approve and release the PO, validate actual receipts, match AP and issue to the location. Return unused material through reviewed evidence.
steps.implementation: Product/UOM/rate/discount/tax and cumulative receipt/bill/credit caps, partial backorders, protected stock/posting evidence and capped native issue/return. Stocked AP assets do not duplicate site-consumption job cost.
steps.passedRegression: Late-bill no-op refresh, cancelled/partial return recovery, source-default protection and three-way matching are included in the passed 193-test native suite.
steps.boundary: Matching uses the approved source, not an unapproved tolerance. Broad optimization, unsupported cost/valuation changes and supplier scorecards remain separate.

steps.title: Same-BOQ subcontract acceptance to payment
steps.operatorFlow: Configure the finance agreement, release the subcontract, approve SES/supplier certificates, create/post/pay matched AP, recover funded advances and release retained amounts.
steps.implementation: One project/BOQ through PR/PO/SES, capped accepted work and billing/credits, posted advance/retention ledgers, native payment and controlled closure.

steps.title: Owner cumulative measurement
steps.operatorFlow: Prepare the next certificate, enter cumulative approved BOQ/variation measurements, finish reviews, then create/post the invoice and reconcile receipts; use controlled credits for corrections.
steps.implementation: Previous/current/cumulative/remaining quantities, frozen measurements, funded-advance and retention caps, negative adjustments and final-account checks.

steps.title: Drawing context and physical/financial progress
steps.operatorFlow: Review controlled drawing/submittal revisions with location/discipline context; accept validated P6 status and compare physical, certified and billed progress separately.
steps.implementation: Controlled revisions/attachments and lifecycle dates, latest accepted budget-weighted physical progress, certified financial progress and posted billing; missing funded-WBS progress remains undefined.

steps.title: BOQ/building reporting and bilingual exports
steps.operatorFlow: Choose company/project/WBS/as-of/location scope, inspect BOQ/building or unbilled detail, drill to sources and export native English/Arabic reports.
steps.implementation: Dated CVR/allocations, current approved cash forecasts, posted financials, explicit unallocated history, XLSX/PDF source-permission checks and maintained JAKH paper layouts using native translations/RTL.
steps.boundary: Actual exports generated; complete visual/customer/mobile UAT remains pending. Cash forecast and posted direct cash movement are not statutory indirect cash flow or consolidation.

steps.title: Decision dashboard and thresholds
steps.operatorFlow: Use permitted dashboard measures and source drill-down; approve exception thresholds/owners/due dates, resolve actions and recheck before closure.
steps.implementation: Separate company currencies, governed project measures, undefined-index handling and deduplicated threshold escalation history.

steps.title: Audit, permissions and identity integrity
steps.operatorFlow: Apply the approved roles; review covered before/after edits, review cycles, source/posted evidence and corrections under the signed-in identity.
steps.implementation: Restricted JAKH financial fields, immutable facts/reviews, protected public context/state/source aliases, rounded-content retry matching, currency-history locking and current-permission reports/exports.
steps.boundary: Engineering tests are not an independent security review or signed customer role-matrix acceptance.

steps.title: Specialist integration interfaces and live acceptance
steps.operatorFlow: Approve source project/WBS mappings, send versioned revision identities to the inbox, inspect errors, retry failures and use normal business acceptance/posting.
steps.implementation: Native expiring API-key intake, reviewed P6/Jisr/plant bindings, validated payload/provenance, immutable inbox and duplicate-safe business preparation.
steps.externalGate: Actual vendor endpoints/service identities, protected credentials, authorized live messages and vendor/customer reconciliation remain required. No live connection is asserted; P6 and Jisr stay their specialist masters.

steps.title: End-to-end and production acceptance
steps.operatorFlow: Reconcile project facts to posted GL/AP/AR, settle commercial balances and field/document actions, approve final account/closure and complete release evidence before authorized cutover.
steps.implementation: Continuous opportunity-to-settled-final-account proof; separate-customer packaging/roles/filestores; pinned lean runtime and bootstrap tooling; retained synthetic recovery evidence; evidence-controlled production gate.
steps.externalGate: Local final regression/bootstrap/preview cutover are verified. Container/hosting deployment acceptance, customer and finance UAT, independent security review, two mock migrations plus reconciled authorized production load, production SSO/MFA/owner control plane, residency/backups/monitoring and UAE/KSA tax/e-invoicing acceptance remain unaccepted.

integrityPolicy: Never use sample values as opening balances; never infer or silently split historical location/currency data; preserve native security, accounting, audit, historical sources and licenses.

Synthetic recovery timing is not production RPO/availability/SLA acceptance; repeat with reconciled customer finance and stock data
Native synthetic bootstrap and local preview cutover are verified; container/hosting deployment and production identity/control-plane acceptance remain pending
Broad SOW assets/WIP, supplier scorecards, assembly suggestions and independently tracked gaps remain separately governed
